    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Admissions
    The evaluator's dispatch table as the store holds it: for each node kind of the catalog, the construct a checked relation admits it as, and the relation's kind.
    Admissions.Admission
    One admission.
    ConceptSetSource
    Where evaluation gets the members of a value set: under a view, the concept set a value set identifier denotes.
    ConceptSetValue
    A concept set, the members a value set denotes under a view, by their nids, with the name a library gave it.
    ConceptValue
    A concept as a library writes it: a code in a system, with a version and a display where given, and the concept's identity in the store where the code system is in the graph.
    Evaluator
    Evaluation over statement sets: a stored library's definitions run for a subject, or for every subject, against the statements a source answers, each node kind dispatched through the relation that admits it.
    ListValue
    A list of values in the order given, allowing a value to repeat.
    Measure
    A measure: two bounds on a measure semantic, each included or not, with two annotations that never bear on comparison: the decimal places a number was written with, whole at zero, and the offset an instant was written with, for writing it out again.
    MeasureSemantic
    What a measure's number means: the coordinate system its value is read in.
    MeasureSemantic.Scale
    The scales a measure can be read on.
    Missing
    A missing value of a kind: what CQL writes as null, of whatever type.
    Outcome
    What a definition came to: a value, or a refusal with its place.
    Outcome.Refused
    A refusal.
    Outcome.Yielded
    A value.
    Presence
    A presence: what CQL calls a Boolean, read as the presence measure kind by logical equivalence.
    RatioValue
    A measure ratio: a numerator measure and a denominator measure kept as written, so that 1:128 stays 1:128.
    Refusal
    Why a definition could not be evaluated, with its place: a node kind no relation admits, a class no bridge covers, an element with no reading, a context with no subject, an operation on a kind of value the construct does not take.
    Refused
    Thrown while a definition evaluates when something is refused; the evaluator turns it into the definition's outcome.
    Report
    What an evaluation yielded: for each definition, its value or its refusal, with the library, the subject, and the view they were computed under.
    Resolution
    The resolution a measure was written at: the precision of an instant, from a year down to a millisecond, with the number of milliseconds a whole unit of it spans where that is fixed.
    Statement
    A statement as evaluation reads it, the query model's own reading: what a criterion tests.
    StatementSource
    Where evaluation gets its statements: for a subject under the view, the statements about that subject; for the unfiltered context, every statement.
    StatementValue
    A statement as a value, carrying the class the retrieve that yielded it named, so that a property access can read the statement through that class's elements.
    Subject
    A subject of record, with the facts of the subject a library may read: the birth date first.
    SubjectValue
    A subject as a value: what a retrieve of the patient class yields in the Patient context.
    Text
    A text, CQL's String, kept as written.
    TupleValue
    A tuple: named parts, each a value of its own kind, in the order written.
    Value
    A value the evaluator holds, of one of IKE's own kinds (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1116): a presence, a measure, a text, a concept, a concept set, a list, a tuple, a ratio, a statement, a subject, or a missing value of a kind.
    Value.Kind
    The kinds a value can be of.
